title: A Choir for the Room
author: Beatrix Underhill
blurb: Coral Reyes, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
